steps.name: A Letter from Jiendia
steps.objective: Travel from the "Quartz Cave" to "Drulridge Village", then talk to Levi.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Oh, you must be... %s. The adventurer who helped Her Majesty resolve the Dragon Emperor's Palace incident...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm Levi Tation of the Jiendia Empire's inspection corps.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Judging by your expression, my name surprised you. Many people react that way.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes. I share his given name, but our family names are different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. I didn't realize...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's all right. Let me introduce myself again.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm Levi, eldest son of the Tation family of the Jiendia Empire.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Her Majesty has spoken of you often. She says you're a truly excellent adventurer...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's an honor to meet you.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: And I'd like to thank you on Her Majesty's behalf.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Your dedication has saved countless innocent lives, and will save many more...

steps.name: Trouble in Drulridge Village
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to Ferdinand in "Drulridge Village" and hear the details.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I heard you've agreed to help our investigation team. The situation here is poor, so there is much to do.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So I'll get straight to the point, %s.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Our investigation team, more precisely the inspection corps, found traces of magic stones near Drulridge Village. We couldn't understand why traces of the stones from the Dragon Emperor's Palace were here.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: As we continued investigating, we learned that a twin-headed ogre named Geminus was leading an ogre force and threatening Drulridge.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: If Drulridge falls, all of Mirgandia could be in danger, so we decided to join forces with a nearby mercenary company.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We divided our people between searching for the source of the magic stones and fighting the ogres.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thanks to the mercenaries, we found fragments of magic stones. One of their members, though not a mage, was quite knowledgeable and helped greatly.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: But during that process, the ogres attacked, and the village suffered damage while we held them off.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: First, we must save Drulridge. Only then can we continue our investigation.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's fortunate that you've come at such a difficult time, %s.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Will you help us? Of course, if you do, we'll provide the information you want as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Including where Iris is...)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: What's on your mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing. I'll help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I made a promise to Her Majesty too...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you. You really are exactly as Her Majesty described. You'll hear the details from Ferdinand.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't accompany you. I have my own work to attend to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go see him.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I leave it to you.

steps.name: The Oscuras Mercenaries
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to Parmila in "Drulridge Village".

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly introduce myself to Ferdinand. He nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Everyone in this village is a druid. Our people believe in nature and follow its ways. After seeking a place with the purest energy, we settled here.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: We lived happily for a hundred years. But a year ago, the twin-headed ogre Geminus appeared from the north and disturbed our peace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A twin-headed ogre...

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: An ogre born with two heads. We didn't even know such an ogre existed in Mirgandia.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Geminus subdued the nearby monsters and other races by force, growing his power. Then he forced us humans to make a choice too.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: He said, 'You too will be ruled by strength.' We were to choose between death and submission.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: How could humans bow to a monster with not a trace of dignity?

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: So we chose to resist, and we have defended our village against them for a long time.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: But our finest warrior, Cloud, was injured, and since then we've suffered more and more defeats.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: ...It's shameful to tell an outsider all this, but what choice do we have? You are someone who has offered to help...

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: That's why we asked the Oscuras Mercenaries, with whom we had ties, for assistance.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: It was good timing, since Geminus's monster army was growing. But even then, we lacked the strength to face them.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Then the Jiendia Empire's inspection corps arrived, and now you, a great adventurer, have come.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: We've only made it this far through everyone's efforts, but it still isn't enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I deal with all the monsters?

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Hmm... It isn't a problem that can be handled so simply.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: You should discuss that with the Oscuras company's leader rather than me. She may be a young girl, but she is exceptionally skilled at directing people in battle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go see Parmila.

steps.name: Mushroom Forest
steps.objective: Defeat [Yaryong] and [Oryong] in the "Mushroom Forest", then turn in the quest to Barmun.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, %s! It's been a while. Did the village chief fill you in? Then I'll explain what we've done so far and how.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our member Barmun discovered a magic stone in Mushroom Forest. More precisely, a monster carrying one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A magic stone came from a monster?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Things are getting complicated. We're working with the Empire and the druid village on several tasks.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: First, guarding and securing the Mushroom Forest area.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Second, watching the Destroyed Castle, the base of Geminus and his monster army.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And third, tracing the source of the magic stones.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The imperial inspection corps is helping with guard duties, so we've taken on that last task.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We have our own aims, and they have theirs. Our interests line up. It's a kind of deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's complicated. So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hmm, wait. You're currently working on a request from the Empire, so technically you aren't doing our work.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You may think you only need to find the source of the stones, but...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, never mind. I'd like you to start by holding off Geminus's subordinates. It'll only take a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Do you need to think about it? If it's unclear, go back and speak to the imperial inspection commander.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Otherwise, head straight to the Mushroom Forest boundary. Our mercenary Barmun and the druid warrior Herais are there. Help them.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The number of monsters keeps growing. The two of them alone will struggle.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...You'll help, right? Of course, I'll pay you. We have more and more payments due from various places.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I've heard the situation, I should help, shouldn't I?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe. I knew you would.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When you enter the forest, you'll see monsters. Don't leave them alone. They're all Geminus's subordinates.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So be careful. All those stories about ogres being foolish and ignorant are old news now. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for worrying, Parmila. I'll be going.

steps.name: Tracing the Magic Stones
steps.objective: Defeat [Topaz Camerons] in the "Mushroom Forest" and obtain the <Dark Magic Stone Fragments>.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You're here. Given the situation, I'll explain right away. The magic stones were found right here in Mushroom Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please go ahead.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You can assume all the nonhuman groups in this area have submitted to Geminus. They keep attacking humans, so we've been dealing with them whenever we spot them.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Then something strange happened. I defeated an unusually strong hobgoblin and checked what it dropped... It was a magic stone.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I couldn't tell what kind, but it seemed to amplify the goblin's strength.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I collected some samples, and then the imperial inspection corps arrived.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You've met Levi Tation, right? He has the kind of looks women like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think plenty of people besides me would agree.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I wonder if someone like that has insecurities about his appearance.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Hehe. I hope he does. It would make people like us feel less cheated!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: People like... us?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I'm joking. Just joking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, why has the conversation gone in this direction?)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Anyway, it's frustrating not knowing where the stones come from.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: For now, all we can do is investigate the monsters nearby. It's a clumsy method, but it's the best we have.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: If we trace where they appear, we may find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think we have less time than we realize. We should hurry.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Then I'll take that side. %s, you take the opposite direction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Be careful too, Barmun.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you find anything?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: No... After dealing with all those monsters charging at us, there was hardly anything useful as a clue...

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I really don't understand. Are the monsters around here not Geminus's followers?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying there could be another faction?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: It's possible. Hmm, what will you do? You may have to investigate somewhere else...

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You heard there was someone besides me out here, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the warrior?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Herais... The self-proclaimed greatest druid warrior. Self-proclaimed, as far as I'm concerned. That older fellow Cloud looked stronger to me...

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: (Barmun looks as though he's angry with Herais.)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I'll stay here. If you're going, go alone. I don't want to run into him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Did something happen between you?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: He growled at me to stay away from the women in the village.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: What kind of man does he take me for...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: All I did was compliment the beauty of the druid women.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: He got angry and said I had no grasp of the situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see why he might.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Anyway, I'll keep looking here for magic stones dropped by monsters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Then I'll go to Herais.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Let's leave this place to Barmun and find Herais quickly.)

steps.name: We Need Medicine
steps.objective: Defeat [Spot Bubbles] in the "Mushroom Forest" and collect <Slime>.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I need to get back to the village, but in this condition... Urgh... Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: W-who are you?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: How did you get this far? I don't recognize your face...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Herais from Drulridge Village, right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: ...If you know my name... then you must be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain to Herais how I came here.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be so wary. I came to help.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: You're working for an empire on a distant continent, searching for magic stones while pretending to help our village, and you tell me not to be wary? Amusing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I understand what you mean. In any case, I'm glad you're not an enemy.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Whatever your reasons, help me now. I'm injured and can't move.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Bring me slime from the Spot Bubbles wandering around the forest.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: With that, I can quickly make some medicine. Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I see. Stay right here, then. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: T-thank you. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: What an interesting outsider... Cough, cough...

steps.name: What Lies Hidden in the Cave
steps.objective: Defeat [Nepandus] in the "Hidden Cave" and obtain the <Suspicious Journal>, then report to [Herais] in front of the "Hidden Cave".

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Thank you. My wounds have healed a little thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: ...Then I'll tell you what you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The source of the magic stones...

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Listen carefully. Pay attention.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: That cave is the Hidden Cave that appeared recently. You could call it the source of the magic stones.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: It's filled with monsters carrying magic stones, and there's a being inside directing them.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: A lich...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. A lich?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Yes. A dark sorcerer who turned himself undead in pursuit of immortality.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I don't know his name, but he must be connected to the magic stones.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Someone near the pinnacle of dark sorcery must have made himself a lich. He surely used his knowledge of dark magic to create the stones.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The stones found around here seem to have been influenced by dark sorcery.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Herais, did the lich cause those injuries...?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: How shameful. A warrior of Drulridge, reduced to this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lich wouldn't be an easy opponent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, if I defeat him, we should find a clue about how the stones are made, right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Don't tell me you intend to face the lich? That's foolish. Even I couldn't handle him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still have to try. We won't learn anything if I don't.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: So you're going inside now? I won't stop you, but...

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Be careful. Don't underestimate anything in that cave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go inside and find the lich.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: You're back. Does that mean you defeated the lich?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It was a little difficult. I found this book there. Would you like to see it?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: A book?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The cover says 'Nepandus.' That must be the lich's name, right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The dark sorcerer Nepandus himself... No wonder he was so strong.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Hundreds of years ago, he was a dangerous man who declared he would create a kingdom of darkness. He threatened everyone with dark magic, particularly necromancy.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: You may not know this, but Freios suffered a major conflict long ago. Nepandus tried to exploit it to make himself king.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: But several powers, including the kingdom that preceded today's Silvaria Empire, discovered his scheme and formed an allied army to defeat him.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I heard he was defeated and vanished without a trace... To think he'd spent all this time as a lich.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: A fitting end for a fool who defied the world's natural order and became undead.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Anyway, you've worked hard.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The information you want should be in this book...

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Go and report to that man Levi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right staying here, Herais? Shouldn't you return to the village?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: You're worried about me? Ridiculous. Focus on your own business.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I'll keep watching that cave. Go back. They'll be waiting for you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Good. Then I wish you luck.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Hmm, so that's what this book is. At a glance, it looks like a journal in which Nepandus recorded his circumstances and research results.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Let me read a little more before I explain.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: (Levi studies the book for a long time with a grave expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it say?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: There's no doubt that Nepandus created the magic stones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. What else?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It seems Nepandus's stones were used to break through the Dragon Emperor's Palace barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's how it's connected.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: But Nepandus didn't do it himself, so we need to investigate further.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then it was the one seen at the palace...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Agasura man with long red hair?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes. You know of him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, does the book mention him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guiyi definitely told me about that person too.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: According to this book, Nepandus hid in the cave and eventually died there.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't know why he never came out again, but something must have happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Herais told me a little about Nepandus. He was defeated by an allied army, disappeared, and took refuge in the cave...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did he become a lich?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: That Agasura man brought him back from the dead, and the revived lich acted on his orders...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Even as a lich, he couldn't break the habit of keeping records. It's all written here. Anyway, I'll submit a report based on this.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Meanwhile, please help the mercenaries. We'd heard of ogre movements at the castle, and our investigation showed...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It seems Geminus is using it as his base. The [Destroyed Castle] on the edge of Mushroom Forest.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The mercenaries are watching it, but they're struggling. If you join them, %s... I'm sure you'll be a great help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go. Don't worry too much.

steps.name: Master of the Monster Army
steps.objective: Defeat [Geminus] in the "Ruined Castle", then report to [Arcane] in front of the castle.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: %s, it's been a while.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: They said reinforcements were coming. I didn't expect them to be you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a long time, Arcane. I'm glad you seem well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, please explain the situation.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'm relieved you're here, but it's difficult to explain clearly.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Facing Geminus is one thing, but the village has its own circumstances too.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: You know something of the village's situation and ours, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Then this will be quicker.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: At the moment, we're struggling just to defend against the monster army. We can't go on like this forever... So we've made a decision.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: A surprise attack. But we don't have anyone with the ability to carry it out.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Everyone is skilled, but they lack experience facing monsters like these.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: It might be different if the companions who followed our former leader were here, but as we are now, we aren't enough.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: So thank you for coming to help.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: You should be able to face that twin-headed ogre, Geminus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you put it that way, I'm a little scared. Can I really do it?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: You certainly can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only came thinking I'd offer a little help.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'll give you information that should help you infiltrate. The ogres tend to be quiet at this time of day. This is our best chance.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'll deal with any ogres coming out here. You handle the inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Since you put it that way, I'll go meet Geminus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Shall we go, then...?)

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: Urgh... Urgh... You're strong, human. You could easily kill me if you wished. Why don't you?

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: ...You look as though there's much you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Geminus, where did you come from? Why did you raise an army here and attack a human village?

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: Do you think I'll simply answer that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A twin-headed ogre nobody knew existed suddenly appears. It's full of questions.

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: I act only on my creator's orders... Unless he wishes it, I will not answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your creator?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could he be an artificial being?)

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: (Geminus does not answer. Under the influence of some force, his body gradually stiffens.)

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: (No trace of life can be felt from Geminus's body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What...? What on earth is happening?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Geminus said that? Hmm... Surely he didn't mean an actual creator god...

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: It's difficult. It sounds as though someone forcibly created a twin-headed ogre called Geminus through experiments...

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Who on earth would plan such a thing...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what I'm wondering too. Why do it in Mirgandia?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I don't know, but could it be because Nepandus was here?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Whoever created Geminus must have come because something they wanted was here.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: They had a plan that required a base in Mirgandia. They created Geminus to lead a monster army and needed land for them to occupy...

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: So they ordered Geminus to secure it. Drulridge happened to stand in the way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels as though the pieces are fitting together.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Anyway, now that the leader has fallen, we'll manage the rest somehow. Thank you. With Geminus dealt with, that weight is off my mind.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: We'll handle the aftermath. Tell our leader what happened.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: You've worked hard. See you again.

steps.name: A New Request?
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to Levi in "Drulridge Village".

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmila looks puzzled after hearing %s's account of what happened in Mushroom Forest and the Destroyed Castle.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I see. Nepandus and Geminus... There must be a connection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After hearing Arcane's thoughts, I think so too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Nepandus was revived, Geminus was created... There has to be something behind it, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thanks to you, things should be easier for Drulridge. The biggest danger is gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then perhaps you can rest a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Parmila?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... You're still putting the pieces together.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes. I really don't want to imagine it, but what if they intended to turn Drulridge into a magic stone research facility or a military base...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wouldn't that make sense?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It certainly seems possible. But it won't happen now, so we're all right, aren't we?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We've put an end to that person's plans.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...Are you subtly boasting that you ended them yourself?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's less self-praise and more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You acknowledged me, Parmila, so I thought it was all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The druids and mercenaries joined forces, and I added my strength too. With all that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel as though I've grown stronger than before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmila gazes at %s's face with an unreadable expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila, why aren't you saying anything?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmila nods without a word.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila? Did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, no. Go to Levi and tell him what you've been through.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Good work. Hehe. See you later. Our company should return to camp once everything is settled here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila waves goodbye to %s.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Things worked out this time, but what on earth is the emperor of Silvaria thinking...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And even setting the Jiendia continent aside...
